interpretation: Synthetic role controls derived from the fixed T85 API shape; expectations concern static evidence roles, not vulnerability labels.

cases.semantics: Public literal names a NAPI property; does not contain the retrieved password value.
Property-name text and the output handle are distinct operands.
A named input value reaches an explicitly public modeled log; candidate-only source heuristic.

cases.argument_role: property_name at 2; actual property value at 3
cases.semantics: Password handle is assigned as the property value, not the public property name.
A variable named passwordText holds an explanatory property-name label; a suggestive name is not a secret-content label.

cases.argument_role: unknown helper role; must not borrow NAPI signature
cases.semantics: Unknown helper may have different meaning even when the operand is a familiar property-key constant.

cases.argument_role: unknown helper role; actual named input retained
cases.semantics: No helper body or argument role is established.
API argument role alone must not prove that dynamically supplied name bytes are public.

cases.argument_role: local function body, external API identity unresolved
cases.semantics: A same-spelled local function explicitly logs its value parameter; external signature assumptions cannot erase the path.

cases.argument_role: property_name at 2; output handle at 3, then converted material reaches modeled log
cases.semantics: Removing a key-name heuristic must preserve returned-value source dependency even with an ordinary output variable name.

cases.argument_role: API return status logged; property value remains in separate output
cases.semantics: A status code is not the retrieved password material.

cases.argument_role: presence boolean logged; no property content read
cases.semantics: Property existence does not supply password content.
